summary: Backend-only testing of Signature Style Interiors leads API via external ingress URL (https://design-spaces-luxury.preview.emergentagent.com). All 12 pytest cases passed: GET /api/ root message, POST /api/leads happy path + minimal payload, parametrized 422 validation for each missing required field (name/phone/project_type/budget_range), 422 for short phones (numeric and with symbols), 422 for short name, GET /api/leads returns list with no _id leak and sorted desc by created_at.

minor.issue: In server.py, logger is used inside create_lead's except block (line 73) but logger is defined AFTER the routes (line 106). If db.insert_one raises, this will trigger NameError before the intended HTTPException 500 is returned. Move the logger configuration above the route definitions.

action_items: Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and `logging.basicConfig(...)` above the route definitions in /app/backend/server.py so the except handler in create_lead doesn't NameError on insert failure.
Optional: add an admin auth guard or pagination on GET /api/leads (currently public, returns up to 500 records).
critical_code_review_comments: logger used before assignment in create_lead exception path (server.py L73 vs L106) - latent bug.
GET /api/leads is unauthenticated and returns up to 500 leads including phone numbers - PII exposure risk; should be admin-protected.

created_at is stored as ISO string in Mongo but model field is datetime; MongoDB sort on string ISO works only because format is lexicographically sortable - acceptable but noting fragility if format ever changes.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads - susceptible to spam submissions.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True (browsers reject this combo); fine while no creds are sent, but worth tightening.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth on these endpoints
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed lead documents in MongoDB (TEST_John Doe, TEST_Jane, TEST_ListProbe, TEST_SortA, TEST_SortB) during test runs. Not cleaned up since GET endpoint is the only read API and cleanup endpoint does not exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend leads API is fully functional via ingress. Phone validator strips non-numeric chars except leading '+', so '+91 8748055124' becomes '+918748055124'. _id is correctly excluded from GET responses. If main agent fixes the logger ordering bug, no retest needed for that change; only retest if the validator or routes are modified.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. The only latent issue is the logger-before-definition ordering in server.py which only manifests on a Mongo insert failure (not exercised in current tests since DB is healthy). Reproduction would require simulating a DB outage.
